text:
Tara: Quick plan — 30m dev lab + micro-benchmark to launch the new RefKit tutorial series. Goal: repo + 3min screencast + short benchmark that proves small infra tweaks matter. Need: landing copy, one-question gate, HubSpot routing, hero image, and snackable clips.
Ben: Target audience = community devs & early-stage infra engineers. Keep demo concise: clone -> run -> enable cache/quant -> show numbers.
Sia: Form suggestion: email + company_size(dropdown: indie/startup/growth/enterprise). Hidden utm & lead_source fields. Map enterprise to AE queue, others get 2-email nurture.
Oli: Bench narrative: baseline vs "RefKit tuned" (batching + prefix-caching + int8). Metrics = p95, cost/1k tokens, and tokens/sec. I'll run the scripts and share CSV + a tiny chart.
Tara: Owners: Ben (repo & screencast), Oli (bench + CSV), Sia (HubSpot + routing), me (slides + blog draft). Design for one hero + 15s social clip please.
Ben: Draft social: "Live lab: Build with the RefKit and reduce inference spend. 30m demo + bench. Wed 11am PT — register: https://redwood.link/refkit-lab". Will make tweet + thread + LinkedIn.
Sia: HubSpot fields: listId=51234, hidden lead_source=refkit_lab_2026, utm_campaign=refkit_lab_q2. Automation: attendee downloads CSV -> tag engaged_hot.
Oli: Repro commands for README:
```bash
# baseline
python bench.py --model small --batch 1 --quant none --iters 100
# tuned
python bench.py --model small --batch 8 --quant int8 --kv_cache yes --iters 100
```
I'll publish results.csv and a tiny notebook.
Tara: We'll record and produce 3 highlight clips (90s, 45s, 15s) for on-demand traction. Post schedule: community channels 24h & 1h reminders.
comms-bot: Reminder scheduled: "RefKit dev lab" Wed 11:00 PT — reminders at 24h and 1h.
Tara: Final checklist posted. Ping here when each deliverable is done. :rocket:
